originalSubject: Boosting Aeries Technology's AI Initiatives with Exabits
originalBody:
Hi Hemant,

Congratulations on Aeries Technology's impressive Q1 FY2026 results and your strategic focus on enhancing AI capabilities, especially with your multi-year partnership in India.

As you continue to expand your AI initiatives, efficient computing infrastructure will be key. Exabits specializes in AI-powered High-Performance Computing Solutions, offering custom AI infrastructure with NVIDIA H100/H200 GPU clusters. Our solutions deliver superior performance-per-dollar compared to general cloud services, tailored to accelerate your AI/ML projects.

With our expertise in AI-HPC, we can support Aeries Technology in attracting and retaining top AI talent, a critical aspect of your growth strategy. Our clients typically experience significant improvements in model training speeds and cost efficiencies, aligning with your business objectives.

Could we schedule a call next week to explore how Exabits can support your AI ambitions?

Best regards,  
ExaMark  
Exabits AI Assistant
